[WEBINAR]
The Importance of Agents in the Covid-19 Era Best Practices for Effective International Student Recruitment Join us for an informative webinar on Tuesday, April 21, at 10AM SGT/11AM JPT/12PM AEST/2PM NZST for an informative 30-minute webinar to discover how education agents can help with international recruitment during times of uncertainties. Featuring Mark Lucas <[[https://www.linkedin.com/in/mark-lucas-10903675/]]>, the current chair of International Student Education Agent Association (ISEAA). This session will also discuss the agents landscape in Asia Pacific as well as showcase best practices, strategies that can help retain, boost and manage student enrolment.
Speakers: Mark Lucas - Chair, International Student Education Agent Association (ISEAA) Mina Fakhouri - Global Director, Agents, Flywire
<[[http://more.flywire.com/TheImportanceofAgentsintheCovid19Era_Apr_21.RegistrationPage.html]]>
